scope: DWG LTYPE_CONTROL phantom-member order in the local writer and compatibility parser

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: Numentries excludes BYLAYER and BYBLOCK; the final two hard-owner handles are ordered BYLAYER then BYBLOCK.

implementation.writer: src/intern/dwgwriter15.cpp now emits the final hard-owner control handles in BYLAYER, BYBLOCK order.
implementation.reader: src/intern/dwgreader.cpp accepts the normative order, the prior libdxfrw hard-owner BYBLOCK, BYLAYER order, and the separately recognized historical all-soft layout.
implementation.candidate: The bounded AC1018 candidate accepts uppercase BYBLOCK for the normative generated profile and tolerates normalized null-xref handle metadata only when the raw field-span check proves the exact H5 null reference.

coverage: writer field order and ownership roles
prior hard-owned writer order remains readable
historical all-soft profile remains separately recognized
malformed count, role, framing and padding rejection with corrected-input retry
generated_controls.fixture_policy: All DWG controls are generated in memory or in scratch files from source code and removed after execution; no external DWG/DXF fixture was added.

validation.build: Focused targets built with the repository warning-as-error flags.

limits: This is generated wire-format and local compatibility evidence, not broad producer interoperability evidence.
The pinned physical AC1018 source still has the anomalous BYBLOCK, BYLAYER order and remains isolated as its observed profile.
No output support claim, whole-document qualification, native CAD acceptance or rendering claim is promoted.
